Slider

Sliding input bar for selecting a value within a given range (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage


<maui-slider value='50' bind:change='onChange' />

Page({
    onChange(event) {
        ma.showToast({
            icon: 'none',
            title: 'Current Progress:'+event.detail,
        });
    },
});

2. Specify Selection Range


<maui-slider value='0' min='-50' max='50'></maui-slider>

3. Disable


<maui-slider value='50' disabled></maui-slider>

4. Specify Step Size


<maui-slider value='50' step='10'></maui-slider>

5. Custom Color


<maui-slider value='50' activeColor='red'></maui-slider>

6. Custom Button


<maui-slider value='50' useButtonSlot>
  <button>testButton</button>
</maui-slider>

7. Binding Events


<maui-slider value='50' bind:dragStart='testDragStart' bind:dragEnd='testDragEnd'></maui-slider>

Page({
  data: {},
  testDragEnd(e) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: 'End dragging',
      duration: 2000,
    });
  },
  testDrag(e) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: e.detail.value,
      duration: 2000,
    });
  },
  testDragStart(e) {
    ma.showToast({
      title: 'Start dragging',
      duration: 2000,
    });
  }
});

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
value Current progress percentage Number 0
disabled Whether to disable the slider Boolean false
max Maximum value Number 100
min Minimum value Number 0
step step length Number 1
bar-height Progress bar height, default unit is px String 2px
active-color Progress bar activation color String #1989fa
inactive-color Progress bar default color String #e5e5e5
use-button-slot Whether to use button slots Boolean false

Events

Event Name Description Parameter
bind:drag Triggered when dragging the progress bar event.detail.value: current progress
bind:change Triggered after the progress value changes event.detail: current progress
bind:dragStart Triggered when dragging starts -
bind:dragEnd Triggered when dragging ends -

Slot

Name Description
- Custom slider button
